title: Prambanan & Ratu Boko Enterprise Point of Sale (POS)
subtitle: Cashier & Multi-Warehouse ERP System across UNESCO Heritage Complex
role: IT Development and Data Management Intern
description: Enterprise point-of-sale ecosystem built for Prambanan and Ratu Boko units to streamline live data integration with company ERP, featuring multi-warehouse inventory mutations and direct Bluetooth thermal ESC/POS printing.
overview: Assisted in engineering the Point-of-Sale (POS) and retail management system for Prambanan F&B and ticketing units under PT Taman Wisata Candi Borobudur, Prambanan & Ratu Boko (TWC / InJourney). The system streamlines operational data integration with the enterprise ERP and improves financial transparency. Built with Laravel 13, Inertia.js, and React 19, paired with a Capacitor Android native bridge for direct Bluetooth Classic (SPP) ESC/POS thermal printing to BP-LITE80D printers with zero browser dialog delay. Handles multi-warehouse inventory, cashier shift reconciliation, and cashier payment method classification toggles for seamless accounting audit.
keyFeatures: Native Android Bluetooth Classic (SPP) ESC/POS printing bridge eliminating print dialog delays (<0.5s auto-cut)
Streamlined data integration with company ERP for enhanced operational transparency and audit accuracy
Multi-Warehouse Inventory Architecture tracking real-time stock mutations, transfers, and FEFO batch allocations
Cashier Shift Lifecycle engine with cash float verification, drawer reconciliation, and comprehensive audit logs
Cashier Payment Method Classification: Quick toggles (Cash, QRIS, Bank Transfer, Open-Bill) to categorize transactions for accurate end-of-shift reconciliation and finance administration
Robust enterprise security with Spatie RBAC, password confirmation step-ups, and anti-bot protection

title: TWC Multi-Destination Venue Booking & Scheduling Platform
subtitle: Internal Enterprise Scheduling & Seating Layout System across Borobudur, Prambanan & Ratu Boko
role: IT Development and Data Management Intern
description: Internal enterprise scheduling platform utilized by PT Taman Wisata Candi to coordinate multi-day venue bookings, load-in setup windows, and tiered seating layouts without double-booking conflicts.
overview: Designed and developed an internal web enterprise platform for PT Taman Wisata Candi Borobudur, Prambanan & Ratu Boko (TWC / InJourney). The system coordinates high-capacity venue rentals across premier heritage destinations (such as Lapangan Garuda, Trimurti Stage, and Ramayana Ballet stages). It features an atomic scheduling validation engine that accounts for multi-phase windows (load-in setup, main event, and tear-down unload) to eliminate scheduling collisions, coupled with an interactive seat allocation module and destination-scoped user permissions.
keyFeatures: Multi-phase conflict detection engine validating load-in, event, and tear-down windows before confirming bookings
Dynamic Seating Chart Management (`kursi`) with row-and-column tier mapping for Ramayana Ballet Prambanan stages
Destination-scoped Role-Based Access Control (Sales scoped to single sites; Admins manage cross-destination bookings)
Comprehensive client history CRM, PIC assignment workflow, and per-user notification read-state tracking
Modern, fast enterprise UI built with Laravel 13, Blade Components, Tailwind CSS 4, and Vite

title: Museum Candi Prambanan — Official Web Portal & Digital Catalog
subtitle: Revamped Official Public Museum Portal & Archaeological Heritage Catalog
role: IT Development and Data Management Intern
description: Official public web portal and digital museum catalog for Prambanan Temple Museum (museumprambanan.twc.id), enhancing digital presence with interactive archaeological artifact galleries and curator CMS.
overview: Revamped the UI and digital experience of the official Museum Candi Prambanan website (`museumprambanan.twc.id`) during my internship at PT Taman Wisata Candi (TWC / InJourney). The platform enhances the digital presence of Prambanan Temple's official museum, providing global tourists, researchers, and archaeologists with an immersive view into historical stone inscriptions (such as Prasasti Siwagrha and Prasasti Klurak), temple relics, and cultural narratives. Includes live visitor tracking and an administrative content management system for curators.
keyFeatures: Revamped UI enhancing the digital presence and visitor engagement of Prambanan's official museum
Public digital artifact & historical site (`situs`) catalog with high-resolution media galleries and historical annotations
Live visitor tracking counter and engagement analytics module
Curator CMS dashboard for managing educational collections, multimedia assets, and exhibition updates
Deployed and running live in production at the official domain `museumprambanan.twc.id`

title: InJourney Destinations — AI Ticketing Assistant & Knowledge Base
subtitle: Customer Support AI Agent & Curated Heritage Ticketing Knowledge Base
role: AI & Knowledge Engineer · IT Development Intern
description: AI customer support agent and domain knowledge base deployed on the official InJourney Destinations ticketing portal, resolving tourist inquiries on tariffs, bundling promos, visiting rules, and climb quotas.
overview: Engineered and structured the comprehensive domain Knowledge Base (KB) powering the customer support AI chatbot on ticket.injourneydestination.id (integrated via the Mekari Qontak omnichannel ecosystem). Formatted multi-destination ticketing rules, promotional bundles (such as Prambanan + Borobudur packages), temple monument climb quota guidelines (naik struktur Candi Borobudur), and visitor dress codes into high-precision grounding datasets. Designed system prompts, intent classification pathways, and conversational guardrails to answer multilingual tourist inquiries and escalate complex ticketing transactions (rescheduling, refunds, payment issues) to human ticketing officers with full customer context.
keyFeatures: Curated Domain Knowledge Base: Structured unstructured ticketing policies, pricing tiers, and promotional bundling rules into verified grounding datasets
AI Agent Prompt Engineering & Intent Resolution: Designed conversational paths, tone guidelines, and intent routing in Mekari Qontak for tourist queries in Indonesian and English
Strict Hallucination Control & Guardrails: Bounded agent responses to verified Knowledge Base facts to prevent false ticketing or policy claims
Human Handover Escalation Workflow: Automatically routes unresolved disputes, refunds, and payment inquiries to human ticketing staff with customer contact metadata
Production Heritage Scale: Deployed on the primary ticketing gateway for UNESCO world heritage sites under PT Taman Wisata Candi / InJourney

title: ASPIRE — Career & Course Recommendation Platform
subtitle: AI-Powered Academic & Career Guidance System
description: An AI-powered platform that parses student academic transcripts (PDF) and leverages LLM analysis to recommend personalized career paths and targeted courses required to qualify for them.
overview: ASPIRE was developed as a capstone team project addressing the disconnect between university curricula and real-world industry demands. As Project Manager and Full-Stack Lead alongside one developer, I architected the end-to-end pipeline: from PDF document ingestion and structured data extraction to prompting large language models for intelligent career gap analysis and course matching.
keyFeatures: Automated PDF transcript parser converting messy academic records into structured student profiles
LLM integration providing contextual career trajectory matching and skill deficiency diagnostics
Dynamic course planner recommending specific university electives mapped to target job roles
Responsive, clean dashboard built with Next.js App Router and Tailwind CSS
Documented user manual and deployment pipeline on Vercel

title: FaveHotel Laundry & Inventory Mobile App
subtitle: QR-Code Driven Operational Logbook & Inventory Tracking
description: Custom mobile application built to replace legacy manual paper logbooks in hotel operations, featuring real-time QR inventory tracking, cloud spreadsheet sync, and automated kitchen closing tools.
overview: During my industrial internship at FaveHotel Bogor, hotel operations relied on paper laundry logs and manual stock-taking, causing discrepancies and delays. I designed, engineered, and deployed a production-ready mobile application from scratch. The solution empowered operational staff to scan linen batches via QR codes, log weights and room numbers, and sync directly to Google Sheets in real time.
keyFeatures: High-speed QR code camera scanner for bulk linen batch and amenity tracking
Live bi-directional synchronization with cloud spreadsheets for immediate management reporting
Kitchen closing-time validation utility and checklist to enforce hygiene and equipment shutdown protocols
End-to-end user testing and on-site staff training sessions conducted solo
Complete user documentation and operation manual authored for hotel staff

title: Console-Based Library Management System
subtitle: Object-Oriented System with Role-Based Access Control
description: Comprehensive console application implementing strict Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) paradigms and custom data structures for multi-role library cataloging, borrowing, and inventory management.
overview: Built as an intensive academic project to demonstrate master-level comprehension of core OOP principles (polymorphism, encapsulation, inheritance, abstraction) and memory-efficient data structures. Features dual-role permissions (Administrator and Guest), transaction ledger records, author-indexed search trees, and comprehensive input validation.
keyFeatures: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) separating administrative stock control from guest search and borrowing
Dynamic catalog searching indexed by author, ISBN, category, and availability
Transaction tracking module with due-date calculation and return validation
Robust input sanitization and exception handling preventing state corruption
Comprehensive architectural user manual detailing system class diagrams
